title: Nitrogen-doped carbon quantum dot, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a nitrogen-doped carbon quantum dot, a preparation method and an application thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: carrying out hydrothermal reaction on a uniformly mixed reaction system containing citric acid, histidine and a solvent at 180-300 DEG C for 3-8 hours, and carrying out post-treatment to obtain the nitrogen-doped carbon quantum dot withthe size of 3-5 nm and the composition elements of C, N and O. The invention also discloses an application of the nitrogen-doped carbon quantum dot in the field of dispersion of graphene in water, and further discloses an environment-friendly graphene dispersing agent which comprises the nitrogen-doped carbon quantum dot and can be used as filler of a water-borne epoxy resin coating. The nitrogen-doped carbon quantum dot provided by the invention has the characteristics of simple synthesis, no toxicity, no harm, excellent water solubility and the like. Meanwhile, the using method is simple, graphene can be dispersed through ultrasound in a water solution, the corrosion resistance of the waterborne epoxy resin coating can be effectively improved, and the waterborne epoxy resin coating is low in dosage, safe and environmentally friendly.
